description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors. We've grown 20x from $5M to $100M+ in annualized revenue run rate in under two years, reaching a $1.5B+ valuation.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - Voice AI Startup Hits $100 Million Run Rate With $4.6 Million Funding https://www.forbes.com/sites/timkeary/2026/11/12/voice-ai-startup-hits-100-million--run-rate-with-46-million-funding/

 - Retell ranked #1 in G2 Voice AI evaluation https://ai.g2.com/evaluations/categories/voice

 - No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/voice-ai-startup-retell-ai-145200025.html

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai




ABOUT FOUNDERS INITIATIVES

Founders Initiatives is a cross-functional team that works directly with Retell's founders on the company's highest-priority opportunities and challenges. Team members are expected to operate across functions, build from first principles, and help scale the business in whatever way creates the most impact.

This is not a narrowly scoped role, it is a high-ownership builder position where you will work across product, engineering, GTM, operations, and AI systems to design and ship core company infrastructure.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, San Antonio Spurs, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

We are hiring a Applied AI Engineer builder to design and implement internal and external AI systems that power how Retell hires, sells, operates, and scales.

You will be responsible for building production-grade AI workflows, automations, and agent systems that directly impact company operations and customer experience.

This role sits at the intersection of applied AI, full-stack engineering, and startup operations.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


HR & RECRUITING AI SYSTEMS

 - Build systems that extract structured signals from resumes (skills, experience, founder traits, domain expertise)

 - Develop lead scoring models to predict interview success and role fit

 - Design AI recruiter workflows for candidate screening and qualification

 - Automate personalized outbound email and candidate engagement workflows


SECURITY & COMPLIANCE AUTOMATION

 - Build automation systems for customer security workflows (BAAs, DPAs, DocuSign, contract review flows)

 - Automate security questionnaire and compliance response generation

 - Improve internal tooling for enterprise readiness and audit processes


OPERATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE TOOLS

 - Build systems for accounts receivable automation and finance-related email workflows

 - Create automated enterprise customer onboarding and account setup tools

 - Design internal systems that reduce manual operational overhead across teams


3RD-PARTY INTEGRATIONS & PLATFORM WORK

 - Integrate with CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel

 - Build workflow automation using tools like Zapier, n8n, and Make

 - Design LLM-powered systems using OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and other models

 - Own API-based integrations that connect internal systems across the company


GTM ENGINEERING & GROWTH AUTOMATION

 - Build HubSpot and Lark automations to improve sales and marketing efficiency

 - Develop lifecycle automation systems for customer engagement and retention

 - Create targeted website personalization and ad content generation systems

 - Build email personalization and outbound automation pipelines at scale
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF YOU

 - Have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

 - Have 2+ years professional software engineering experience

 - Have 1+ year of startup experience and are comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration.

 - Think like a founder and operate with high ownership

 - Have strong software engineering skills (backend, full-stack, or systems)

 - Have hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents in production

 - Are comfortable working across product, engineering, and operations

 - Move fast, iterate quickly, and are comfortable with ambiguity

 - Prefer building systems over working on narrowly defined tasks

 - Care deeply about real-world impact over theoretical work
   
   


JOB DETAILS

 - Location: Redwood City, CA, US - relocation provided 

 - US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, F-1 (OPT/CPT), and O-1 visas.
   
    


COMPENSATION

Our compensation ranges reflect different scopes of responsibility and cash/equity options. Your offer will depend on the skills and impact you demonstrate during interviews, the scope of the role, and your preferred cash/equity balance.

Annual base salary ranges:

 - Senior: $210,000–$250,000

 - Staff: $200,000–$300,000




OTHER BENEFITS

 - 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - $70/day DoorDash credit for unlimited breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

 - $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement

 


COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - Best Offer Upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed.

 - Top 1% Talent: Above-market pay (top 5 percentile) to attract exceptional builders.

 - High Ownership: Small teams, >$1M revenue/employee, and significant equity.

 - Performance-Based: Offers tied to interview performance, not experience or past salaries.



INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Intro Call (15-20min): Connect with our talent team to get a deeper look at the team and the work you'd be doing.

 2. First Technical Phone Interview (45 min): System Design & Project Deep Dive

 3. Second Tech Screen (45min): Tools & Automation

 4. Final Interview 
    
    - Coding and Technical Round (90 min)
    
    - Cross-Functional Interview (30 min)
    
    - Past Project Deep Dive (30 min)
